name: Enchanté Chocolate Mille-Feuille & Warm Apple Tatin vs. Signature Lemon Dessert
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement
whyItWorks: At Enchanté dinner or the "Just Desserts" event, the Dark Chocolate Mille-Feuille, Vanilla Tahiti Custard, and Warm Apple Tatin are smooth and citrus-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Dark Chocolate Mille-Feuille, Warm Apple Tatin, or Vanilla Bean Custard with a Lactaid pill; strictly skip Chef Lallement's Signature Organic Lemon Dessert (confit lemon + citrus).
watchOuts: Strictly skip the Signature Organic Lemon Dessert (pure citrus confit)
